motion_core_fbtypes_KVPCfgDoubleUnit.description:
Table for just one single double value, which has a unit (can be used for any floating point numbers, that are not unit-less)
When you read the data: the unit is defined by the unit configuration of the related axis or kinematics.
When you write the data: the given unit is used for scaling; when not given, then the unit for scaling is defined by the unit configuration of the related axis or kinematics.
Leave unitType and unitAddInfo out, when you just modify the data. Use them only, when you change the type of the struct or create a new entry.

unit.description: the unit of the value as string

unitAddInfo.description: additional information on the unit type
